Round 217 passes: all 8 checks pass, I found no bugs, and the 3 real-browser checks ran, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. I didn't claim the gate row (full test suite, build, `npm run verify`); root's gate covers it.

- **Scope (start and end):** HEAD is still `eb9e76e` and `git status` shows the expected 4 modified and 3 untracked files. All 1,063 frozen files hash unchanged (rc 0). The two files A was allowed to edit end with exactly the hashes A reported.
- **Budgets file:** still 61 rows with the same ids, order and key order. Exactly 9 rows changed, and only in `kind` or `note`, word for word as the task specifies. The rows that only check something exists (`clips-*`, `export-*-produced`, `js-*-seen`) are still `deterministic`.
- **Doc 169:**
  - The new `## არქიტექტურა` section sits right after `## მიდგომა`.
  - The Mermaid diagram appears once, identical to the original.
  - The 7 template headings are in template order and the status line (l.4) is exact.
  - The `kind` column matches the budgets file on all 61 rows, and every cited row id exists.
  - Every change maps to one of the allowed edits (a)–(f).
- **Perf run (real browser):** exit code 0 in about 61 s, complete, no failures. The 38 `deterministic` rows have the same medians as round 216. `used-ready-mib` gave [5.1, 5.1, 5.1] and passed the in-run consistency check now that it is back in the `deterministic` set. The two placeholder `latest*.json` files I put in place beforehand were untouched, and I removed them afterwards.
- **Proof the checks still bite:** A's mutant (`kind: "flaky"`) fails at load with the expected loader error. My mutant (`mem-polls-1` must be ≥ 1000) fails on that row only, so relabelling it `wallclock` did not switch off its check. Neither run hung.
- **Typecheck:** rc 0, and the budgets JSON parses.
- **Premium access (both viewports, no credentials):**
  - `/studio-lab` opens with the demo badge.
  - `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio.
  - The token endpoint returns 401 with no header and 500 with a fake Bearer; the 500 is allowed because the mock backend isn't running.
  - No token is issued, so premium auth is not bypassed.
- **Studio smoke (both viewports, real mouse):** adding the demo clip and exporting gives `czaba-studio-lab.wav`: PCM, 2 channels, 48 kHz, 24-bit. Its length is 0 frames off the "WAV created: 01:41.352" text, the audio is real (−15.29 dBFS, 99.8 % non-zero samples), and there were no page errors.

Two things for B:
- **Repeat test-script timeout:** on the first run, the 1440 access check timed out on the page-ready wait. A diagnostic re-run (2 of 2) and a full clean re-run passed. The same check failed on its first attempt in round 216, so it is now twice in a row. My guess is a dev-server reload wiping the page right after it loaded, but I haven't confirmed that. B may want a warm-up page load in the shared check script.
- **Poll counts above the note ranges:** in this round's runs, A and I both saw counts above the round-216 ranges written in the notes: `mem-polls-2` reached 16, `-1.6x` 13 and `-2.6x` 22. That isn't a failure: the notes say "observed in round 216", the rows are now `wallclock`, and every count is well above the ≥ 5 limit. B may want to widen the ranges.
